description: Implement Subconscious Processing engine and integrate all new modules into the main agent loop. The subconscious runs background analysis between main cycles. Integration wires health monitor, connectivity, scheduler gates, prompt guard, token compression, and context manager into the existing agent architecture.
steps: 1. Create src/core/subconscious.ts implementing background processing (adapted from OpenHuman's subconscious module):
- Define SubconsciousTask: { id: string, name: string, handler: () => Promise<SubconsciousResult>, intervalMs: number, lastRun: number, enabled: boolean }
- Define SubconsciousResult: { insights: string[], actions: string[], escalations: Escalation[] }
- Define Escalation: { level: 'info'|'warning'|'critical', message: string, source: string, timestamp: number }
- class SubconsciousEngine with constructor(deps: { memory: MemorySystem, llm: LLMFunction, healthMonitor: HealthMonitor })
- registerTask(task: Omit<SubconsciousTask, 'id'|'lastRun'>): string
- async tick(): Promise<SubconsciousResult> - run all due tasks, aggregate results
- getEscalations(since?: number): Escalation[]
- Built-in background tasks:
- 'memory-pattern-scan': every 30min, scan recent memories for emerging patterns that haven't been captured by the learning system
- 'market-sentiment-check': every 15min, analyze recent observations for market condition changes
- 'strategy-health-check': every 20min, check if any strategy has degraded performance silently
- Export from src/core/index.ts
2. Integrate HealthMonitor into src/core/agent.ts:
- Import HealthMonitor from ./health-monitor.js
- Create HealthMonitor instance in constructor
- Call healthMonitor.markOk('agent') at end of successful start()
- Call healthMonitor.markOk('scheduler') when scheduler starts
- Call healthMonitor.markError('agent', error.message) on fatal errors
- Replace the existing simple checkHealth() method to use healthMonitor.markOk/markError and check healthMonitor.isHealthy()
- Expose getHealthMonitor(): HealthMonitor accessor
3. Integrate ConnectivityMonitor into src/core/agent.ts:
- Import ConnectivityMonitor from ./connectivity.js
- Create ConnectivityMonitor instance in constructor with Solana RPC and OpenRouter as critical endpoints
- Replace the existing checkConnectivity() in src/index.ts to use the monitor
- Add scheduler task 'connectivity-check' every 2 minutes calling monitor.checkAll()
- When connectivity is lost, emit alert and pause strategy evaluation
- Expose getConnectivityMonitor(): ConnectivityMonitor accessor
4. Integrate SchedulerGate into strategy evaluation in src/core/agent.ts:
- Import SchedulerGate and gate factories from ./scheduler-gate.js
- Create a SchedulerGate with conditions: connectivityGate, healthGate
- In evaluateStrategies(), call gate.canProceed() before evaluating
- If gate fails, log which conditions failed and skip the cycle
5. Integrate PromptGuard into the LLM pipeline:
- Import PromptGuard in src/core/llm-router.ts
- In routedChat(), check user messages through promptGuard.check()
- If verdict is 'block', throw a new error (PromptInjectionError) without calling the LLM
- If verdict is 'review', log warning but allow (for autonomous agent, external inputs like GitHub issues could trigger false positives)
- Add PROMPT_GUARD_ENABLED config option (default 'true') to src/config.ts
6. Integrate token compression into LLM router:
- Import compressForLLM from ./token-compression.js in src/core/llm-router.ts
- Replace the existing simple compressContext() function to use the new compressForLLM()
- Apply compression to all messages when content exceeds 2000 chars (not just LIGHTWEIGHT tasks)
- Log compression stats when ratio < 0.5 (over 50% reduction)
7. Integrate SubconsciousEngine into src/core/agent.ts:
- Create SubconsciousEngine instance in start() after other systems init
- Register scheduler task 'subconscious-tick' every 5 minutes calling engine.tick()
- On escalations with level 'critical', emit alert event
- Expose getSubconscious(): SubconsciousEngine accessor
8. Create tests/core/subconscious.test.ts:
- Mock LLM and memory dependencies
- Test registerTask and tick() calls handler when intervalMs elapsed
- Test tick() skips tasks not yet due
- Test escalations are collected and retrievable
- Test disabled tasks are skipped
9. Update tests/integration/agent.test.ts or add tests/core/agent-integration.test.ts:
- Test that agent creates health monitor and marks OK after start
- Test that scheduler gate blocks evaluation when connectivity is down (mock ConnectivityMonitor.isOnline to return false)
acceptance_criteria: HealthMonitor is integrated into agent lifecycle with proper status tracking
ConnectivityMonitor replaces ad-hoc connectivity checks with structured monitoring
SchedulerGate blocks strategy evaluation when preconditions fail
PromptGuard screens LLM inputs and blocks injection attempts
Token compression is enhanced with the new compressForLLM function
Subconscious engine runs background tasks on schedule
All new and existing tests pass
No breaking changes to existing APIs (backward compatible)
